headline: Securitisation volume hits record ₹1.47 trillion in H1 FY27: ICRA
hook: Record volume in the first half
summary: Indian securitisation volumes reached an all-time high of ₹1.47 trillion in the first half of financial year 2027, according to a report by ICRA. This milestone reflects robust activity in debt origination and transfer markets. Strong performance in asset-backed and mortgage-backed securities drove the growth during the period. For Indian retail investors, the data signals active credit liquidity and healthy underlying asset portfolios for participating financial institutions and NBFCs.
why_it_matters: Higher credit liquidity supports NBFC funding and lending growth.

headline: ICRA files SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate for Q2 FY2026
hook: Routine quarterly filing submitted to regulators
summary: Rating agency ICRA has submitted its mandatory dematerialisation compliance certificate to SEBI for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for listed entities to confirm the electronic holding of shares. For an Indian retail investor, this is routine corporate administration with no direct bearing on the company's financial performance or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: No impact on share price or company fundamentals.
